payload.summary: There is evidence of a brute force attack targeting the labadmin account on the host victim-web-01 from the IP address 198.51.100.23. The attack involved 15 failed login attempts within a short time window, and no documented changes explain this activity. The account is protected and privileged, making it a high-value target.

attack_chain.description: An attacker attempted to gain access to the labadmin account on the host victim-web-01 by performing a brute force attack using the IP address 198.51.100.23.

risk_factors: The account is protected and privileged, making it a high-value target.
The attack involved multiple failed login attempts within a short time window, indicating a potential brute force attack.

proposed_actions.justification: The account is being targeted by a brute force attack, and it is a protected and privileged account. Disabling the account can prevent further unauthorized access.
